versions.changelog:
Initial release of the S2 Brand Personality Profiler.

- Implements the 5维度-18层面-51人格 Chinese brand personality model.
- Uses a search projection algorithm to quantify brand trait prominence versus industry averages.
- Provides automated Python-based calculation and personality judgment (A/B/C level).
- Outputs structured reports with n-value analysis, personality assessment, and consumer adaptation recommendations.
